# SH-2 sensor hub library

These ten C/header files were copied unchanged from the station's working
`/home/eamars/workspace/imu-lab/rd` on 27 September 2026. That lab used the
Adafruit BNO08x SH-2 port. The original upstream revision was not recorded.
Copyright/license notices are retained; see LICENSE (Apache 2.0).

Upstream API: https://github.com/ceva-dsp/sh2
Adafruit integration: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_BNO08x

The station-specific Linux I2C port is `../../tools/imu_bno085.c`.
